messages:
Olivia: Thanks everyone for the great all-hands — quick follow-up on the pricing/credits section: we had a few asks about prepaid credits and the grace period, so collecting questions here.
Raj: Is the prepaid bucket model going to support rollover between months or only on a per-contract basis?
Marco: Short answer: standard prepaid (monthly commit) won’t auto-rollover, but annual commit customers can get rollover in the contract addendum. Will add to docs.
Jen: Can we clarify the grace period behavior if a prepaid customer exceeds their monthly bucket during a high-traffic incident? e.g., is there automatic soft-throttling or immediate hard cutoff?
Marco: We plan a 72-hour grace window for prepaid tiers that lets traffic exceed the monthly bucket while we notify and try to auto-charge/notify. After grace window, traffic is throttled to the account’s rate cap until payment/remediation.
Mike: How will that interact with Dedicated customers and burst capacity? We had a support case where burst was consumed by a spike and customer worried about post-spike billing.
Marco: Dedicated customers get separate billing — burst within Dedicated is free up to configured burst capacity; if they exceed the committed threshold, we raise an alert and bill overage based on the reserved contract terms.
Lina: For hosted users, are rate limits enforced per-token or per-request? Need to know for SDK timeouts.
Raj: Rate limits are per-route token and per-request throughput. Short story: token-level accounting for quota, request-level for concurrency and PPS. We'll publish the exact formula in the API docs.
Jen: Request: can we add an example in docs showing how a long streaming response counts toward quota? That was confusing in the Q&A.
Marco: Good call — example coming. Example will show streaming chat: client receives streaming tokens, we count generated tokens against the model token unit in real time.
billing-bot: Notice: customers on trial tier get a 7-day grace before hard quota cap applies. Billing tickets created automatically on threshold breach.
Olivia: On the topic of soft-limits vs ratecap backoff — leadership asked whether we should auto-scale customers into a higher tier temporarily during outages. Pros/cons?
Mike: Operationally risky. Auto-upgrading could hide abuse and increase liability. Prefer auto-throttle + emailed product-solution flow to offer temporary uplift.
Lina: From DX perspective, a clear self-serve button in the Console to request emergency burst (with checkbox for billing approval) would reduce support volume.
Raj: Proposal: Console button triggers a 24h emergency boost, sends a billing pre-authorization, and creates an Ops ticket. If accepted, we lift ratecap; if declined, we keep throttling. Thoughts?
Jen: +1 for transparency. Also need guardrails: only x boosts per 90 days, and an audit log entry.
Marco: We'll draft a policy doc: preauth hold amount calculation, boost duration, TTL, and audit requirements.
Olivia: One more on credits: people asked if unused credits from a canceled Dedicated contract are refundable or transferable.
Marco: Generally non-refundable but transferable to another account under the same legal entity. Exceptions need finance approval. We'll add the details to the dedicated contract FAQ.
Raj: Can we set up a short customer-facing FAQ/one-pager and an internal runbook for support to reference? I'd like this live before we announce any packaging tweaks.
Olivia: Agreed — timeline: Marco + Jen to ship the FAQ draft by EOW, Raj to review for support, Finance to sign off on wording for refund/transfer.
Jen: I can draft the FAQ, will ping Finance and Legal for final language.
billing-bot: Action logged: FAQ draft assigned to Jen (due in 5 days).
Mike: Small ask — let's also add a section in the SDK docs about client-side token accounting and retry semantics under rate limits.
Lina: I'll take SDK doc PR once Mike outlines the snippet.
Olivia: Thanks — this thread will help keep a single source of truth. If anyone else has edge cases (marketplaces, reseller flows, VPC/on-prem customers) drop them here. :thumbsup:
Raj: Adding note — reseller flows will likely need bespoke onboard terms. Please flag early.
Marco: Follow-up meeting proposed with Finance + Legal + Product next Tue 10am PT to finalize policy.
Olivia: Perfect. Closing thread for now, but keep replies if new questions come up.
